audience: tour, class and appointment businesses that take bookings with Bookeo

useCases.title: Find open seats on tours and classes
useCases.text: The AI lists available slots with seats left in a window of up to 31 days, or finds slots that fit a party size, with an estimated price.

useCases.title: List bookings in a date range
useCases.text: The AI lists bookings by start time or last change, with customer and participant details, and summarizes the week.

useCases.title: Check payments received
useCases.text: The AI lists payments in a period, split by payment method, and shows the payments and refunds of one booking.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their bookings
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by name or email and shows contact details, past bookings, cancellations and no-shows.

useCases.title: Hold seats and create a booking
useCases.text: The AI holds seats to get the final price, then creates a booking for an existing or new customer. No payment is recorded.

useCases.title: Reschedule or cancel a booking
useCases.text: The AI changes a booking's time, participant counts or options, or cancels it. No cancellation fee is charged.
